zh-CN.title: 克己复礼为仁
zh-CN.subtitle: 《论语》颜渊篇
zh-CN.shortSummary: 这句经文把仁与自我约束、礼制实践连接起来，后来在政治和教育语境中不断被重新解释。
curatorialDescription: ‘克己复礼’不能只被读成个人道德训诫；它还连接身体、礼仪、教育和政治秩序，是儒家概念进入制度生活的一个入口。
zh-CN.researchNote: Alpha 条目以篇章定位为起点，后续补充注疏、异文和唐代经学使用语境。

interpretation.zh-CN: 在颜渊篇的语境中，仁与约束自我、实践礼相连；它不是脱离关系和制度的抽象善意。
interpretation.en: In the context of the Yan Yuan chapter, humaneness is connected with self-restraint and the practice of ritual; it is not an abstract goodwill outside relationships and institutions.

en.title: Conquer the self and return to ritual
en.subtitle: Analects, Yan Yuan chapter
en.shortSummary: The line connects humaneness with self-restraint and ritual practice, and was repeatedly reinterpreted in political and educational settings.
curatorialDescription: ‘Conquer the self and return to ritual’ is more than private moral advice. It connects body, ritual, education and political order and opens onto the institutional life of Confucian concepts.

profile.modernZh: 约束自己，使行为回到礼的规范，就是仁。
profile.translationEn: To restrain the self and return to ritual is humaneness.
